title: [IMP-25] Push registration endpoint at the relay is ambiguous
description: Review finding IMP-25: Push registration endpoint at the relay is ambiguous (lens IMP). Location: spec/11-transport.md:184, :194-203, :253-254, :407. Fix: The "same path" point is not itself ambiguous, because the proxy and the relay are different origins, and an absolute path on the relay origin is resolvable as with `/v1/agora/blob/` (10:570). The real conflicts: the §11.8.8 table says registration happens on the live stream only, while §11.7.3 step 4 uses HTTP. Also missing: the relay TTL field, the relay-side DELETE, and how the old `pushHandle` is carried (11:253). Pick one transport (a Control message per IMP-1 is consistent with the table) and give a body with `replaces`. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/11-transport.md §11.4 PushRegister CDDL (live stream only, ttl, replaces, empty tokens = delete) and §11.7.3 step 4, §11.7.6 replaces; consistent with §11.8.8 table
